verses.text: Bless Jehovah, O my soul. O Jehovah my God, thou art very great; Thou art clothed with honor and majesty:

segments.text: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment;

verses.text: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a vesture; The waters stood above the mountains.

segments.text: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a vesture;

verses.text: At thy rebuke they fled; At the voice of thy thunder they hasted away

segments.text: At thy rebuke they fled;

verses.text: (The mountains rose, the valleys sank down) Unto the place which thou hadst founded for them.

segments.text: (The mountains rose, the valleys sank down)

verses.text: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; That they turn not again to cover the earth.

verses.text: They give drink to every beast of the field; The wild asses quench their thirst.

segments.text: They give drink to every beast of the field;

verses.text: By them the birds of the heavens have their habitation; They sing among the branches.

verses.text: He watereth the mountains from his chambers: The earth is filled with the fruit of thy works.

verses.text: O Jehovah, how manifold are thy works! In wisdom hast thou made them all: The earth is full of thy riches.
